At the Republican midterm convention in Dallas on September 10, 2026, Trump claimed he had built almost 2,000 miles of border wall and warned that under no-cash-bail policies, people accused of murder could be released within hours.

FactCheck.org examined both claims in its review of the convention’s second night.
